हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: The Broken Billionaire " is a high-stakes microdrama that follows the emotional and professional transformation of Gyan, an AI prodigy who sacrifices a lucrative career to serve as a secretary for Neeta, his long-time unrequited love. For four years, Gyan manages Neeta’s life and company, "Near Solutions," while secretly living in her mansion under a pact: if her true love never returns, she might accept him
